destination.file_contract: The existing Stage 1 forest renderer passes these packaged textures/stage1 PNG paths to BladeStage1ForestTextureLoad, which reads them with sprite_add for model and billboard textures. The project includes these files through datafiles/textures.

The existing Stage 1 forest renderer passes these packaged textures/stage1 PNG paths to BladeStage1ForestTextureLoad, which reads them with sprite_add for model and billboard textures. The project includes these files through datafiles/textures.

The existing Stage 1 forest renderer loads these packaged sprites/stage1 PNG paths with BladeStage1ForestTextureLoad and sprite_add, with explicit frame counts for sprite sheets. The character selector also loads the player PNG paths named by its content catalog. The project includes these files through datafiles/sprites.

The existing Stage 1 forest renderer loads both packaged sprites/stage1 ordinary-fae PNG atlases through BladeStage1ForestTextureLoad and sprite_add for enemy and effect atlas drawing. The project includes these files through datafiles/sprites.

The existing BladeFrontendUiCreate loader reads the packaged ui/blade_frontend_panels.png with sprite_add, then configures native nine-slice guides on the created sprite. The project includes this file through datafiles/ui.

The Stage 1 forest renderer passes models/stage1/lost_forest_terrain.vbuff to BladeStage1ForestBufferLoad, which reads the packaged file with buffer_load and creates a frozen vertex buffer with the 36-byte normal-bearing vertex layout. The project includes this file through datafiles/models.
